business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and sells sleepwear, loungewear, greige fabric and processing services through Hong Kong, PRC, Cambodia, Vietnam and Honduras operations.
business_overview.revenue_model: Fixed-price product sales and processing services; revenue recognised from manufacturing and sales of sleepwear products, loungewear products, greige fabric and processing services.
business_notes: Customer A and Customer B contributed HK$784.911m and HK$240.999m revenue respectively in 2024.
The group had factories or production bases in PRC, Cambodia, Vietnam and Honduras; Cambodia new factory was in trial-run/lease expansion in 2024.
The company is Cayman incorporated and HK listed; parent company functional currency is USD while consolidated statements are presented in HKD.
